extracted.name: Cheesecake in a Jar
extracted.description: Make cheesecake in a jar for the perfect portable summer dessert that's incredibly easy to make and a delicious way to use seasonal strawberries.
ingredient_lines: 6 pecan shortbread cookies (such as Keebler® Sandies), finely crushed
instruction_lines: Mix cookie crumbs, butter, and 2 tablespoons sugar in a bowl until combined. Divide mixture evenly among jars, about 3 1/2 tablespoons each, and gently press (do not pack) into bottoms.
Halve 6 strawberries for garnish, and set aside. Chop remaining strawberries.

Beat cream cheese, 1/2 cup sugar, and lemon juice in bowl with an electric mixer at medium speed until smooth. Fold in whipped cream and chopped berries; divide evenly among jars, about 1/2 cup each. Top each with a 2 berry halves and cover with lids. Chill at least 2 hours and up to 3 days.
